title: reversible PS4 cover clue provenance audit
marketing_status: Existing external-consumer audit records an iam8bit post describing the reversible slip cover as containing a hidden clue.

historical_observations.claim: community explicitly described two cover screens as holding a planet and a nut/acorn and proposed the covers might guide already-active ARG puzzles
community explicitly noted a monitor showing only the top half of the acorn while the boy looks toward an actual running man outside
community returned to the same partial-acorn/running-man relation and argued the cover clue might have been rendered moot once the acorn puzzle was solved

classification: strong historical candidate for a cross-puzzle/metaclue, weak direct CE-foreground consumer
consequence: Downgrade the cover as a direct consumer of E2/terminal outputs unless a new cover-native registration is found. Preserve it as evidence that CE packaging can point back to earlier puzzle components and partial/layer-specific reading.
